items.action: Master copied intact; verify DAW export range against this file.
795-point tempo curve imported; master zeroBeat 7 verified by source/master waveform correlation.
Timing accepted by user on 2026-11-08. Preserve existing edges; develop visual scenes and choruses.
Lead/backing active-clip analysis proxies made at master clock. Post-device processing not recreated; master is listening authority.
Character sheet and four supplied screenshots copied from illustrated-singer, originals retained.

workflow: Ingest master and current DAWproject; record hashes and matching version/range.
Verify export start/end, master zeroBeat, tempo ramps, meter, stems and any audio offsets/warp.
Build exact bar/beat/seconds grid; compile frame boundaries at chosen fps.
Import author lyric text. Run unprompted Whisper as evidence, then align reviewed text in broad phrase/section windows.
Review word attacks, held endings, repeated phrases and backing/echo distinction against master; preserve raw outputs and approved corrections.
Build editable EffectCraft lyric-timing animatic and review before detailed shot planning.
Author shots in shots/shotlist.json, preserving creative edits with --merge; review animatic before generated motion.
